blocks.html: For permitted uses denoted with “*” for parking requirement category (PRC) in Section 32-151 (Use Group V – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply. For transient hotels, floor area used for sleeping accommodations shall be classified as PRC F2. Floor area used for meeting halls, auditoriums, eating or drinking places, wedding chapels or banquet halls or radio or television studios shall be classified as PRC B1.
blocks.plainText: For permitted uses denoted with “*” for parking requirement category (PRC) in Section 32-151 (Use Group V – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply. For transient hotels, floor area used for sleeping accommodations shall be classified as PRC F2. Floor area used for meeting halls, auditoriums, eating or drinking places, wedding chapels or banquet halls or radio or television studios shall be classified as PRC B1.

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Economic Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Reorganized use provisions into new use group structure in Sections 32-11 through 32-20; relocated hotel provisions from Section 32-02 to Section 32-153 and health and fitness establishment provisions from Section 32-413 to Section 32-163; incorporated special permit references from Section 32-30 into use group provisions
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to support economic growth and resiliency by providing businesses with additional zoning flexibility to locate and expand
